purpose: Physical outdoor illumination and reflection contract for the 4K live-action fidelity target. This contract does not award Visual Fidelity points without actual Unity render evidence.

benchmarkContext.sunPolicy: The same SummerSun directional light must drive scene shadows and the procedural sky sun disk. A second contradictory key light is forbidden.

solarShadowCaptureCoherence.rebuildInvariant: Every QualityBlockEnvironmentContext.ApplyToDirectionalLight call reapplies the complete shadow/camera/LOD stability state so a fresh generated-scene rebuild cannot reset settings validated earlier.
solarShadowCaptureCoherence.historicalDriftClosed: Environment solar application previously wrote shadowBias=0.04 and shadowNormalBias=0.28 after the separate shadow-stability contract expected 0.025/0.38. The runtime source of truth now reapplies 0.025/0.38 plus the complete stable shadow state.

ambientAndDefaultSpecular.intent: Sky fill and default specular energy must respond to the same visible outdoor environment rather than an unrelated flat ambient wash.

rendererProbePolicy.reason: Outdoor objects must transition from local reflection context back to default sky reflection rather than exhibit hard cubemap boundaries.
rendererProbePolicy.requiredCompletionCondition: Every registered probe must return a non-negative RenderID, report IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)=true, and expose a created 512x512 Cube realtimeTexture before native-4K Camera.Render starts.

atmosphere.causalIntent: subtle humid midsummer aerial depth only; no near-field blue wash

lookdevGenerationBrief.facadeGlass: At frontal view, retain readable but subdued non-emissive interior backing. At oblique view, sky/building/ground reflection contribution should rise. At grazing view, specular/Fresnel response should become dominant without turning the pane into cyan chrome or a painted highlight.
lookdevGenerationBrief.paintedMetal: Rail and painted steel should show narrow, roughness-controlled environment highlights that change with camera angle and geometry, never fixed bright streaks in albedo.
lookdevGenerationBrief.concrete: Rough concrete should retain broad low-energy response and readable micro-normal grazing detail without mirror-like reflections.
lookdevGenerationBrief.shadowAndSky: Visible sun position, the sole directional key, key-light direction and cast-shadow direction must agree in all benchmark views. The 58.11 degree elevation / 244.23 degree azimuth source sample is configuration evidence only; actual shadow bearing must still be verified from rendered pixels.
lookdevGenerationBrief.exposure: Sunlit facade texture and cloud/sky structure must retain highlight detail; shaded recesses and non-emissive window interiors may be dark but should not collapse into featureless black everywhere.
lookdevGenerationBrief.probeSeams: No hard reflection transition, cubemap orientation discontinuity, or sudden brightness jump may be visible while moving through overlapping probe volumes.

verification.note: Implementation metadata only. Real Unity 3840x2160 captures, verified probe refresh receipt, pre-cull guard execution, and 100% crops are mandatory before visual scoring.
